_comment: Shared expectations for the two password-policy mirrors:
Both test suites read this file, so a rule or a wording change on one side
fails the other's tests instead of silently letting the checklist and the
server error disagree. The realm these mirror is set by
checks the mirrors against a real Keycloak carrying that policy.
'unmet' lists rule ids in declaration order; 'message' is the exact
user-facing sentence, or '' when the password is compliant.

cases.name: the reported bug: 15 chars, all digits
cases.message: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter and at least one uppercase letter.

cases.name: too short, but otherwise compliant
cases.message: Password must contain at least 12 characters.

cases.name: letters only, lowercase
cases.message: Password must contain at least one digit and at least one uppercase letter.

cases.name: no lowercase
cases.message: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter.

cases.name: no uppercase
cases.message: Password must contain at least one uppercase letter.

cases.name: no digits
cases.message: Password must contain at least one digit.

cases.name: short and missing three classes: oxford-comma join
cases.message: Password must contain at least 12 characters, at least one digit, and at least one uppercase letter.

cases.name: non-ASCII uppercase counts, as it does in Keycloak (Java Character.isUpperCase)
superscript two is category No, not a digit to Keycloak
cases.message: Password must contain at least one digit.

cases.name: password equal to the email, every other rule satisfied
cases.message: Password must not be the same as your email address.

cases.name: equality is case-insensitive to us, unlike Keycloak's own check
cases.message: Password must not be the same as your email address.

cases.name: merely containing the email is fine — equality only, never containment
email as password, also missing digits and uppercase: both sentences
cases.message: Password must contain at least one digit and at least one uppercase letter. Password must not be the same as your email address.
